age.evidence: Age of the bank client, in years.
age.guess_rationale: Bank clients are adults, so 18 is a semantic public lower bound. A 100 year upper clipping bound is conservative for human age.

balance.guess_rationale: Account balances can be negative due to overdrafts and can be large positive values. These bounds are conservative public clipping guesses, not empirical dataset extrema.

day.evidence: Last contact day of the month.
day.guess_rationale: Calendar day of month is exactly bounded by 1 and 31.

duration.guess_rationale: A call duration cannot be negative. One hour is a conservative clipping bound for a marketing phone contact.

campaign.evidence: Number of contacts performed during this campaign and for this client.
campaign.guess_rationale: A contacted client has at least one campaign contact. Fifty contacts is a conservative practical clipping bound.

pdays.evidence: Number of days since previous campaign contact; -1 means client was not previously contacted.
pdays.guess_rationale: -1 is a documented special value. 7300 days is about 20 years and is a conservative clipping guess for elapsed days.

previous.evidence: Number of contacts performed before this campaign and for this client.
previous.guess_rationale: A count of previous contacts cannot be negative. Fifty contacts is a conservative practical clipping bound.
